title: Stochastic CHAOS: Why Deterministic Inference Kills, and Distributional Variability Is the Heartbeat of Artificial Cognition
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical properties of LLM inference (determinism vs. stochasticity) and its impact on performance, reasoning, and safety (specifically jailbreaks and toxicity). It does not evaluate religious, theological, or moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
